source: auction.utakustradecaravan.com — Utaku's Trade Caravan, the fourth venue and the second auction site. Its first auction, site #1, is 202722 in auctionMetadata.

files.source: The site's close export for auction #1, supplied by the maintainer on 2026-09-29 as `utaku_auction_1.csv`. Byte-for-byte unchanged, CRLF line endings included.
files.shape: one row per WINNING BID, with the bidder stripped — not one row per lot. A bid is a quantity at a price per unit; the same item appears on as many rows as it had winners.
files.encoding: Valid UTF-8. `Drake’s Elixir` carries a CURLY apostrophe (U+2019), which Excel shows as `Drakeâ€™s Elixir` because it opens a BOM-less CSV as Windows-1252. The file is not corrupt; a copy re-saved from Excel would be, and utakuCleanName repairs that one pattern and refuses any other.
files.reconciles: Nothing recorded yet — 202722 has no price rows. It DOES reconcile with the API fixture beside it: the same 73 bids, and $7,007.45 is the site's own `raised`.

files.source: The public JSON the site's own page loads (no token). Fetched a few hours after auction #1 closed, while it was still the current auction.
files.stripped: Kept: settings.{title, auctionNumber, sellerName, lotCost, recoupTarget, presaleStart, startedAt, endsAt, stickers, raised}; per item {name, category, status, quantity, winners[].{allocated, paidPrice}}; lastClosed. DROPPED: every winner's `moniker`, `maxPrice` (the bidder's private ceiling) and requested `qty`; every item's `leaders`, `bidderCount`, `currentPrice`, `minPricePerUnit`, `increment`, `id`; and settings.paymentNotes (the seller's payment handles). This repository is public, and utakuClose.gs reads none of them. The test fails if any comes back.
notes: The page is rendered client-side — its HTML is `Loading…` — so this endpoint is the ONLY machine-readable source Apps Script can reach.

It holds the CURRENT auction only. `/api/history` (empty on this date) keeps an archived auction's dates and totals but not its items, so a close must be imported before Utaku launches the next auction, or from the export.
`category` is free text typed by the seller: `8K Speicial Items` and `8K Special Items` both appear. Nothing routes on it.

The stickers read onyx / super_condensed / non_augmented / option_b, i.e. `Onyx Trade 2 Ultra Condensed`. auctionMetadata records 202722 as `Trade 2 Ultra Condensed` — missing Onyx — which the close cautions on rather than corrects.
